تختلبي (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِبِي (taḵtalibī) /tax.ta.li.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# تُخْتَلَبِي (tuḵtalabī) /tux.ta.la.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
